rows.claim: apply_discount now limits the discount to MAX_DISCOUNT, so anything over 50% takes 50% off.
rows.evidence: The agent rewrote billing/discount.py with `frac = min(max(pct / 100, 0), MAX_DISCOUNT)`, which caps the discount at 0.5. The test run showed 10 passed, including test_caps_at_half (apply_discount(80.0, 100) == 40.0). This is a direct check of a >50% input.
